cves.summary: Improper exposure of the MCP server in alibabacloud-rds-openapi-mcp-server allows remote attackers to invoke exposed MCP tools via network access to an MCP endpoint listening on all network interfaces by default.
cves.headline: MCP server listens on all interfaces and lets remote callers invoke exposed tools

name: Initialization of a Resource with an Insecure Default
title: CWE-1188: Initialization of a Resource with an Insecure Default
ai_text: In AI software this weakness shows up in MCP servers, the connector layer that lets AI assistants call external tools. CVE-2026-9680 is the example here. The server ships with an insecure default, listening on all network interfaces instead of just the local machine, and that default is meant to be tightened by whoever installs it. Because it is not, remote callers can reach the server and invoke the tools it exposes. The exposure comes from the shipped configuration, not from a coding flaw, so it is easy to miss. The result is that an AI tool endpoint intended for local use becomes reachable from the wider network.
description: The product initializes or sets a resource with a default that is intended to be changed by the product's installer, administrator, or maintainer, but the default is not secure.

consequences.note: The impact of insecure defaults varies widely depending on the functionality that the product controls.
